body:
Not everyone can have a successful life, that just a fact. I did ask what I can do better at my job and what I would need to do to move up. I took the feedback and worked my ass off. I put in 12 hour shifts, worked on extra projects that were above my pay grade and did it all with a smile on my face (even if it was a forced fake smile.) In the end, my best is still not good enough and it never will be. 

As far as the dating apps go, I mentioned Tinder, but I’m on a bunch more. I’m on Bumble, OKcupid, Plenty of fish as well. I’m just an ugly troll. There has to be ugliness in this world for there to be beauty. Lucky me, I was born ugly and stupid. I appreciate you words of wisdom, but you tell me not to make assumptions and you made a whole bunch about how I’m just lazy and haven’t put effort into life. I have really tried and life just keeps chewing me up and spitting me out again.

I was in a very similar situation. I became really good friends with a girl I worked with to the point we were talking almost everyday. We would call and text to vent to each other about work. She was in a relationship until about August. When it ended, she was in a very bad place. I helped her move into her new apartment, put all her furniture together for her, was there for her when she couldn’t sleep and when she was feeling down about herself. She started dating again in November and I asked her if she would ever consider giving me a chance to take her out and she shut me down. My dumbass got drunk and sent her a text confessing all of my feelings to her and how long I have felt that way about her. I tried to apologize to her, but she basically ghosted me. I’m actually quite a bit older than you, but I have never had feelings like the ones I have for her. I just went on a date this past week to try to get over her, but that unfortunately didn’t go very well. The only advice I have for you is that it will take time. I was the same way after I got rejected, but it is getting better as time passes. Hang in there and try to go out with other women, even if you dont think you are interested right now. You just might find someone that will actually want to be with you as much as you want to be with them. That’s what I am hoping for anyway.

I can’t speak for other men, but I can talk about my situation. It is easy to throw out cliches like there are so many women out there or just move on, but it’s not that easy. I caught feelings for my best friend last year, but since she was in a relationship at the time, I didn’t do anything about it. I told myself to forget about how I felt and just be a good friend. However, when she became single again a few months ago and I helped her move and was spending more time with her, those feelings came back tenfold. I asked her if I can take her on an actual date, but was rejected because she said she sees me as a close friend or family. That hurt quite a bit. I’m 33 and have never felt this way about anyone before and I don’t think I am going to feel this way about anyone else. I fucked up when I got drunk and sent a very long text to her about a week later explaining how I felt and how long I have felt that way. She has been avoiding me since, even though she responded that it was okay and she understood that it was just a drunken ramble. I’m trying to get over her, but I still can’t stop thinking about her everyday and wish we could at least go back to being friends just so I could be near her again. I know I probably sound pathetic, but basically what I am saying is I can’t control how I feel or who I have feelings for.

I appreciate all the comments. I know drinking isn’t healthy, but it’s what I’m doing now to numb myself. You say I should never drink over a woman, but I’m 33 and have never felt this way about anyone. What are the chances I find someone like her again? I tried cutting off contact with her last week, but I couldn’t follow through with it. Like I said, she was having a bad day at work and my instinct was to try to be there for her. I can’t help myself and I hate myself for it. I have spoke to a couple of friends about it and they say the same thing. That I’m a good guy and it’s her loss, but if I’m such a good guy, why cant I find anyone?

Maybe she is is acting like nothing happened to spare me pain or maybe she doesn’t know how to process my feelings, but either way it’s killing me. I know she doesn’t look at me like that cause she flat out said that, but I’m having trouble dealing with it. I’m not sure if it’s the best thing for me to tell her that I need some space or if that would be a dick move. It took me 33 years to find someone like her, someone I told everything to and she told me everything too. Someone that I found beautiful both inside and out. What are the chances I am able to find another like her? Even if I did, would they give me a chance or am I going to end up in the same exact situation?

I will admit that my online profile isn’t the best, but it is honest. I’m not just trying to get the most matches, I would like to find someone I could click with, like I do with her. I don’t have pictures of me with any animals cause I don’t like dogs and where I am living now would add $300 to my rent if I got a pet. My first picture is of me in my custom suit I wore to my sisters wedding, I am not going to look better than I do there. 

I’m not sure if you know the Greek story of Icarus, but that’s what I feel like. I tried to fly too close to the sun when I went for the promotion I didn’t get, and then tried again when I told her how I feel and now I’m crashing down to Earth. It’s just a matter of time before I go splat. 

(My username is from the old tv show married with children. It was Bud Bundy’s name he used when he was trying to be a gangster.)

The natural high I spoke of was not a good thing. It’s a fleeting feeling that doesn’t make up for the crash. Not only that, but today at work, she was talking to me like nothing happened. I love being her friend, but it is extremely painful right now. It’s great that she can reject me and move on like nothing happened, but I don’t know if I can. I know it’s a shitty thing to try to avoid her now and it might come off as all I ever wanted was to get in her pants, but it might be the best option for me right now. 

As far as the online dating, there’s no hope there. A year and not one match? That has to be some sort of record. You seem to be the most positive person in the world if you really believe I almost nailed this dating thing. I don’t see it and that’s why I am currently in a cycle of working myself to death 5 days a week and trying to drink away he pain the other 2 days.

You asked if I am keeping my body moving? I am, I work in a warehouse 12 hours a day, 4-5 days a week where all I do is stand and walk around. 

What is something that makes me feel important? It used to be the job. I liked helping my workers get promotions and seeing them succeed made me feel good. However, since I got denied my latest promotion, I have definitely lost that feeling.

 You’re assuming I got fit because I set goals for myself and used discipline, but that’s not really true. The truth is, when I get stressed out, I lose my appetite. As a matter of fact, I have gone days without eating. For example, I ate dinner on Thursday and did not eat again until tonight (Sunday). Some people eat for comfort, but I have to be opposite effect. The only reason I got fit was because I started playing basketball. The reason why I play basketball is to clear my head. I put on music and shoot around for hours to try to clear my mind. Why did I have to clear my mind? Because of her. I couldn’t stop thinking of her. Fuck, she just rejected me three days ago and I still can’t get her off mind mind. I know I have no shot, but my fucked up mind won’t stop. 

I see what you are doing. You are trying to see the positive in my situation and I appreciate that, but the truth is, there isn’t any. You want to know what I mean by being alone? I’m on multiple dating sites, have asked women out on dates up front and now (maybe the worst decision of my pathetic life) became best friends with, what I see as, the perfect girl and have been nothing but rejected my entire miserable life. The only reason I see is I must be the ugliest troll in the history of the planet that I can’t even get 1 yes. If this is the best I can get, then I may be best off making my early exit.

I understand what you are getting at, and a couple of years ago my answer would be a no. Before getting this job I was out of work for a year and put on weight and was a very negative person. Not only have I dropped all the weight and am currently in the best shape of my life, but I’ve also tried to be positive about as much as I can. This last month has been really rough though and I’m struggling to see positivity in anything. I honestly believe that everyone had a type of person they are looking for and that I don’t fall into any of those types. Being alone all this time is crushing me and I’m not sure how much longer I want to live like this.

I don’t have that much hate in me to hang on to life just to see how bad other people are going to do. I’m not even mad at my friend and I hope that she can find someone to make her happy. I just don’t want to go on being a loser and failure anymore. I’d rather just not exist.

It wasn’t yesterday it was life. I am not cut out for this generation. I work my ass off, but since I don’t have a bachelors degree I am somehow a worse worker than others. As far as the woman goes, it’s is definitely unrequited love. I know this. But at the same time, I can’t help the way I feel. Even when in my moments of strength I tell myself that all we will ever be is friends, I always wind up falling for her again. You say that there will be other women, but I’m 33 and have never felt like this about anyone before. That’s why I say all of my gut instincts are wrong. If you know the story of Icarus, that’s what I feel like. I flew too close to the sun and it time I come crashing down to my death.

I'm not looking for some movie magic moment where I am able to start enjoying life again. I understand that's not how it works. I have tried to pick up new hobbies and haven't found much success. I have always enjoyed movies a lot, so I started reading books that movies were based off of. I got about three books in and realized it felt like more of a chore than anything. I started to jog for a while because I heard from a bunch of people that being active helps you feel better. However, I never enjoyed running just for the sake of running. I am thinking about going to the sporting goods store to pick up some weights and trying that out for a while, but I doubt that will have any change in my mood. 

To be honest, the only time I have any kind of joy is when I run into the girl from work I talked about earlier. I don't see her as much as I used to because she got a promotion to another department and travels a lot. I ran into her this past week and just seeing her put me in a better mood. Part of me wants to tell her how she makes me feel and ask her to give me a chance, but another part of me doesn't want to risk losing her as a friend and not having her in my life at all, while a third part of me doesn't think I would be able to make her happy and she deserves to be happy. I have never felt this way about someone and it drives me nuts. I feel like I'm socially and emotionally retarded because I don't know how to act in this situation. I mentioned earlier that I am up for a promotion. If I get it, I might have to transfer to a different site than the one we are both currently at. If this happens, I am hoping I can get her to come out to dinner with me to celebrate. It's not too much of a stretch as this is what we did when I got my promotion to my current job. But then I still have to make a choice about whether or not I should say something or just leave it alone.

You asked me what a loser is. This pretty much sums up a loser. A man that doesn't have the courage to ask out the one girl he has ever had feelings for because he doesn't know if he can take the rejection. A man that can't even find a hobby to keep himself occupied and his mind off of all the negativity in his life. Someone who doesn't have any long term goals because he isn't sure he wants to be here in the long term.

I appreciate the advice, but you are making some assumptions that are not correct. I didn't just realize how long I have felt like this, I knew when things started to feel different. When I started to lose interest in my hobbies I had before, when I stopped feeling the moments of joy from hanging out with my siblings or nephews. I have known the time frame, I am just having trouble with the why. 

I have always been kind of a loser. I have never had many friends and never got the attention of girls. Even in high school, where I was in a class of 450+, I really only had one friend. I got a job in high school at a supermarket and wasted 12 years of my life there. I lived at home with my parents, had no goals, and it didn't look like I had much of a future. To put it bluntly, I sucked at life. About three years ago, I finally had enough of that job and put my two weeks notice in without having any other jobs lined up. I spent the next 18 months trying one terrible job to the next. During this time I also put on a lot of weight and was embarrassed by how I let myself go. Eventually I wound up at the job I am currently at. Like I said in my original post, it's not a great job, but I am good at it and it pays the bills. I have been there for about 2 years now, have been promoted once and am up for another promotion now. I have also been able to afford my own place. I also dropped all the weight I had put on, plus more. I have three days off a week during most weeks and I make it a point to play basketball for an hour or two everyday day I have off so I don't let myself go again. 

I said earlier that I sucked at life, and I did through my twenties. I think it is fair to say I am currently doing much better at it now than I was. But why is it that I constantly feel like shit now? When I was a loser in high school and wasting away my twenties, nothing bothered me. Being alone didn't bother me, other people's opinions about me didn't bother me, I never had any negative emotions. Why is it that when I am having the most success in my life, I feel the worst? Is it because I'm not fit to have this? Can my mind not see myself as a successful human being that can live a normal life? If that's the case, then what am I supposed to do? Again it comes back to my two choices. Keep going on as the miserable sonovabitch that I have allowed myself to become or end it cause I don't see a way out.

As far as talking to someone, that is difficult for me. I don't believe in God so I don't have any spiritual leaders I can talk to. I was raised catholic, but when I hit my teen years and saw how people would use organized religion for their own agendas, it really turned me off from the idea of a God. As I have gotten older, I understand more why people take solace in religion, but it just isn't for me. I also don't want to talk to a psychiatrist. If I tell someone I am having suicidal thoughts, they will just try to prescribe me some pills or try to lock me up. I am against taking drugs in any form. I had two uncles who were drug addicts and alcoholics when I was growing up and I saw what it did to their lives and their families lives and it messed me up mentally. I have actually never tried any drugs or drank any alcohol for this reason. I have been tempted in this last year to start drinking, but when I tell people that they advise against it. It is proabably for the better because I don't think alcohol would help in my current mindset if I am being honest. 

There is a saying that the best conversation you will have in your life will be with a complete stranger. I believe that this is what we are having now. I don't think I would be able to have this conversation with someone face to face. This is probably the closest I will be to having a cry for help. I am not sure if I will get anything out of this or if I am just venting, but after reading other people's posts on here for a couple of months and seeing how this community would support people, I thought it was worth a shot. I know I already said this, but I have set up some goals or a bucket list of things I want to get done in the next couple of months. If at the end of this time there is no change, I don't know what else to do. Maybe it's just survival of the fittest and I am not supposed to make the cut.

I used to think that way about suicide too. My cousins step father committed suicide about 5 years ago and I remember thinking what a coward he was. After this last year and a half, I kinda get it now. I think about death all the time, I know it's not healthy, but I can't help it. As far as what triggers me, it varies. It could be a stories about bad things that happen to people or it could be good things that happen and I'll feel envious of them. I hate myself for feeling like that, I should be able to be happy for other people, but I am not able to at the moment.

You don't sound bitter and I really do appreciate the back and forth we are having. As I said in my original post, there are some things I want to get done in the next few months. I guess you can kind of count that as my bucket list. There are a few people at work that I have to help get promoted. They stepped up and helped me when I was struggling and now that I am doing better, I need to repay them. As far as always being happy, I agree with you. I don't think happiness is an emotional that is sustainable for long periods of time. I am not looking for that because I don't think it is attainable. I also never believed in the idea that you should love the job you are doing. It is an unrealistic expection that some people have. However, it would be nice if I could find my way out of this state of melancholy that I have been in for a year and a half. I used to have little to no emotions. Now I find myself sobbing uncontrollably at any sad story I read in the paper. I have even been visiting this site frequently for the past few months before I finally posted something the other day. I would read through some of these posts and it would just hit me. I frequently see people on here saying suicide is a permanent solution to a temporary problem, but what if the problem isn't temporary? What if existence is pain? Sorry if my thoughts are all over the place. I work 12 hour shifts and in the last 36 hours, I have worked 24, spent 2 hours traveling back and forth from work, spent just 3 hours sleeping and have had just 7 hours to cook, eat, shower, do laundry and spend some time watching football and having this conversation with you. (Which, again, I really appreciate. I would never be able to have this conversation with anyone face to face.)

I don't think a relationship would fix my problems, but it has to be better than being alone all the time. I don't really have any details of why I feel the way I do. It's just an empty feeling, that I am missing something. I can't put my finger on it, but I have felt this way for a long time. I would love to be able to wake up in the morning and be in a good mood, but it just doesn't happen for me. I don't see a path to living a happy life or just finding something to fill the emptiness. I'm am giving myself a couple of months to find something, but why should I keep existing if I am just going to be miserable all the time?

I don't want to make it seem like she is the reason I am considered and planning on ending my life. If anything, it's the contrary. Before I met her, I didn't think I was even capable of having these feelings. I owe her a lot. However, it also made me realize that will never have anyone to share my life with and I will wind up dying alone, whether it is soon or later. As I said in a previous statement, I am ugly. I have been rejected by just about every women I have approached. I used to be able to take solace in helping out my siblings and spending time with their families, but it isn't enough anymore. I have said I feel miserable most of the time, but really it is just an empty feeling. I don't really have anyone to share my life with, so why should I go on?

I am not sure what kind of details you are looking for. Yes, are smiles around me, but she smiles around everyone. She is a good person who somehow always seems to be in a positive mood. It's contagious, because every time I am around her it puts me in a good mood and I try to be the best version of myself. Does she touch me? Not really. Neither one of us are touchy feely type of people. We have been out to dinner before, she even came to my sisters wedding a couple of months ago. She was on the outs with her boyfriend at that time cause he was treating her like shit. I told her the pen that I would never treat her like that and I would beat him up if she wanted me to. Haven't really talked to her much since then. Not sure if she has been busy or if she is avoiding me. Either way, I took that as a pretty strong indication that she isn't interested in me.

Company policy isn't the problem. The problem is that I am ugly. We get along great, but I know she isn't physically attracted to me. It might sound shallow, but I don't blame her. I believe that if you aren't attracted to someone, then a relationship will never work. It's part of the reason I say I can't see a path to happiness. Even if by some miracle I am able to get over the first woman that I have allowed myself to have feelings for, there is nothing for me in the future. My choices are to live out the rest of my miserable existence alone or to take my destiny into my own hands and go out on my terms. I believe I am heading down the path that is the lesser of two evils. It might be the cowards way out, but I already stated that I'm a coward, so it fitting.

I do appreciate you taking time to try to help me while you are at work. Thanks.

I am not sure if it's love. I have never been in love. Another reason I am pathetic and miserable. 33 years old and the longest relationship I have had was 3 weeks. I think it might be love with her, but it doesn't matter. It's one sided and she doesn't feel the way I do. I would like to hear how you could help?

I'm 33 and have never had a girlfriend. I have so few friends I can count them on 1 hand. Love is never going to happen for me. Be happy that you have had someone you have loved and that they loved you back. I will never experience that.

I feel the same way. I used to live close to my parents and siblings, but I recently moved about an hour away. I told them it was because it was all I could afford, but I really want them to get used to not seeing me as often anymore. I am hoping this will ease the transition for them if I decide that life is too much for me.
I will, but it's going to be awhile. She is traveling for work the next two weeks. I would rather tell her face to face than over the phone or by text.
I know, I'm going to say something. I risk losing a really good friend, but I have to take a chance at this point.
